name: NumberField
summary: Numeric field with decrease and increase controls, for a quantity you nudge.

a11y.apg: spinbutton, and the engine deliberately does NOT use role=spinbutton. Measured on 31/07/2026: it renders type=text with inputMode=numeric and aria-roledescription="Number field". A native number input brings tiny stepper targets, wheel-scroll accidents and no locale parsing; this keeps the keyboard contract and drops those.
a11y.keyboardNote: Measured in a browser on 2026-08-27 (apps/keyboard-probe + tests/visual/teclado-motor.spec.ts). Confirmed: ArrowUp, ArrowDown, Home, End. Declared and not confirmed in this snapshot: PageUp, PageDown. Absence of an observable change does not prove absence of effect — a generic DOM snapshot can prove a key does something, never that it does not.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: Controlled or uncontrolled. `null` means empty, which is not the same as zero.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires with the parsed number, or null when the field is cleared.

props.name: min / max
props.description: Bounds. The engine clamps and disables the control that would cross them.

props.name: step
props.description: How much each press moves the value.

props.name: format
props.description: Currency, percent or unit, formatted by the platform's Intl — {style: "currency", currency: "BRL"} replaces the money-formatting library a consumer would otherwise install for this alone. The engine formats when focus LEAVES the field, which is what accessibility guidance recommends and the opposite of a live mask.

props.name: locale
props.description: Which locale formats the number. Pass it when the value's locale is a property of the data (a price in BRL) rather than of the reader.

props.name: name
props.description: Form field name. It is also what makes the engine render the hidden input carrying the RAW number, so what a form submits is 1234.5 and never the formatted text.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the field. Use with `Field` when there is a visible label.

props.name: disabled / readOnly / required
props.description: Standard form states, forwarded to the input and to both buttons.

props.name: scrubbable / scrubDirection
props.description: Opt-in drag handle: pulling it changes the value, which beats forty clicks on + over a wide range. Purely additive — the two buttons, the arrow keys and Home/End are untouched, and the handle itself is aria-hidden because dragging is a pointer gesture with no keyboard equivalent to promise. The axis is a class, not a data attribute: the engine does not publish direction.

props.name: className
props.description: Merged onto the outermost element, after the Aurea skin — your class wins on a tie.

props.name: id
props.description: Id of the focusable control, which is what a <label htmlFor> has to point at. Generated when you do not pass one.
